description: The American AMG company is world-famous for its production of Hummer. Ute, the founder of AMG, was a bicycle manufacturer who established the Overland Automobile Division in 1903. In 1908, John Willy purchased the Overland Automobile Division and established the Willys-Overland Automobile Company in 1912 to produce the Willys-Overland Automobile. In 2009, Tengzhong Heavy Industry failed to acquire Hummer from General Motors.
